title: polystichum munitum f. nudatum
intro: Polystichum munitum f. nudatum, commonly known as Mountain Holly Fern, is a subspecies of fern that is native to the Pacific Northwest region of North America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to support respiratory health, and its health benefits include potential relief from coughs, colds, and other respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Holly Fern include its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties, which help to reduce inflammation and promote the removal of mucus from the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
